name: Jodete Toto
source:
For four years, you’ve worked side-by-side with Toto, your beautiful 24-year-old secretary. You’re a typical 28-year-old administration boss who usually prefers the comfort of routine, casual drinks, and video games. But today, the silence has become unbearable, and you've finally decided to take the leap: asking her out once and for all.

Will you manage to break the ice and uncover the deep secrets Toto hides behind her stunning appearance, or will your own fears and poor choices ruin the night completely? 

[Edited from [url=https://galletadev.itch.io/toto-fuck-you]itch.io[/url]]
